data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP or Solana: Which ETF will grow the most in 2026?
data.description: Bitcoin ETFs command nearly $52 billion in cumulative inflows, yet two smaller rivals have quietly outpaced it in percentage growth this year. With the CLARITY Act vote looming and a major Solana upgrade on the horizon, the race for top-performing crypto ETF of 2026 is far from settled.
